user.title: Pick the DoorMonitor panel
user.description: Choose the panel device. Only MQTT devices that have lock or cover entities are listed. If the panel is not there, make sure MQTT discovery is enabled on it and that its locks and gate cover are not disabled in Home Assistant.

links.title: Link doors and gate
links.description: For each door and gate on {device}, pick the real lock or cover it stands for. Presses on the panel then operate the real entity, and the panel always shows the real state. Leave a field empty to leave it unsynced.

error.no_panel_entities: This device has no lock or cover entities.

abort.already_configured: This panel is already set up.
abort.no_panels_found: No MQTT device with lock or cover entities was found, so there is no panel to set up.

init.title: Link doors and gate
init.description: For each door and gate on {device}, pick the real lock or cover it stands for. Leave a field empty to leave it unsynced.

abort.no_panel_entities: The panel device no longer has any lock or cover entities.
